data.notes: December 2026 in Verbier looks confirmed mainly around winter-season après-ski and nightclub residencies, with Polaris already finished in late November.

events.title: Farinet Winter Live-Band & DJ Residency
events.summary: Hotel Farinet’s winter season page confirms live band music in the après-ski bar every night, live DJs in the lounge until 02:00, and the South nightclub open until 04:00. The listed winter opening period runs from 1 December 2026 to 25 April 2027.

events.title: Farm Club Winter Season
events.summary: Verbier Tourisme lists Farm Club’s winter opening period from 20 November 2026 to 11 April 2027, with late-night Friday and Saturday hours from 23:00 to 04:00. The club is described as a long-running Verbier nightlife institution founded in 1971.

events.title: New Year’s Eve at W Living Room
events.summary: W Verbier’s festive programme lists New Year’s Eve at the W Living Room with dinner, DJ sounds, live entertainment and a midnight show. Party access is advertised from 23:00 until late, with reservations required.

events.title: Le Mouton Noir Après-Ski & DJ Season
events.summary: Le Mouton Noir’s official page confirms its winter 2026/2027 season from 11 December 2026 to 11 April 2027 and bills the venue as a high-mountain restaurant, après-ski and DJ spot on the Ruinettes slopes. This is one of Verbier’s on-slope daytime party options.

events.title: Taratata Late-Night DJ-Set Season
events.summary: Verbier Tourisme confirms Taratata’s winter opening period from 3 December 2026 to 30 April 2027 and describes it as a festive late-night venue with DJ sets, dance and concert services. It is a restaurant-led nightlife pick rather than a one-off concert.

events.title: Farinet Lounge Bar Winter DJ Nights
events.summary: Farinet’s lounge season runs nightly from early December with cocktails from 16:00 and DJs taking over from 21:00, making it one of the resort’s core late-night dance options during the winter opening period.

events.title: SOUTH Restaurant & Club Winter Club Season
events.summary: SOUTH reopens for the winter season as Farinet’s Asian-fusion dinner-to-nightclub room, with tables clearing after midnight for resident and guest DJs through the early hours.
